description: A CDN stylesheet URL is part of a redirect loop: critical gives up and uses the last 302 body as the sheet, which parses to an empty sheet.

thin.note: A failed stylesheet on another host (CDN / third party) is skipped with one logSafe'd warning and the job succeeds. critical does not drop this sheet: after its redirect budget it takes the body of the last 302 response as the stylesheet, the css parser rejects it and the sheet becomes an EMPTY element in the join. expected-thin.css (critical's output when the sheet is simply missing) is therefore one newline shorter than expected.css. (In these fixtures {{site}} and {{cdn}} share the hostname 127.0.0.1 and differ only by port: the stylesheet same-host rule compares hostname:port with the scheme ignored, the notion the url() rebasing uses.)
